online.heading: Read your story
online.provenance: On-device draft · on-device Chrome model · 21.7s · prompt kinwoven-draft-v1
online.caption: A simple Sunday morning tradition is remembered from photographs.
online.story: The family ate together at a table in the kitchen every Sunday. The radio was always playing, and Mum would hum along while she poured tea. It's nice to remember the sounds of the day! What do you remember about this day that the photo cannot show? Perhaps you remember what the radio was playing, or what Mum hummed! We appreciate all of your wonderful memories.
